title: Notifications
subtitle: Approvals, announcements and updates in one place
preferencesHint: Choose which notifications you want to receive.
showOlder: {count, plural, one {Show # older notification} other {Show # older notifications}}
desc_absence_request: When a team member requests time off you need to approve.
desc_absence_decision: When your own absence request is approved or declined.
desc_upload_request: When someone submits a file for your approval.
desc_upload_decision: When your uploaded file is approved or declined.
desc_chat-message: New messages in your direct messages and group chats.
desc_chat-mention: When someone @mentions you in a conversation.
weeklyReportHint: Every Monday: tickets, error reports and suggestions from last week against the week before.
digestHint: One email each morning with anything you haven't read yet. Nothing is sent on quiet days.
browserHint: System notifications on this device when you're not looking at the intranet.
browserDenied: Notification permission was denied in the browser.
browserDeniedHint: Notifications are blocked for this site in your browser. Enable them in your browser or OS settings, then turn this back on.
sectionDeliveryHint: How notifications reach you when the intranet isn't in front of you.
section_chatHint: Direct messages, group chats and mentions.
section_draftsHint: Draft versions colleagues share with you, and comments on them.
desc_draft_shared: When a colleague shares a version of a draft with you.
desc_draft_comment: When someone comments on a draft version you shared or were shared.
accessRequestsHint: Always delivered to managers so nobody is left locked out.
weeklyDigestHint: Every Monday: what was announced, posted and added to the wiki last week, policies waiting for you, and next week's events. Only sent when there's something new.
